description: Safely inspect a Room or SQLite database inside an installed app. Lists package databases, shows schema, or executes one validated read-only query. Requires a debuggable app (run-as) or root; uses device sqlite3 when available and otherwise a bounded read-only host snapshot.

access.description: Access method. auto prefers run-as and falls back to root.

action.description: List databases, show sqlite_master schema, or run a read-only query

database.description: Database filename inside the package databases directory (no path separators)

maxRows.description: Maximum rows returned for SELECT/WITH queries (1-1000, default 100)

packageName.description: Installed Android package whose databases directory may be inspected

query.description: One read-only SELECT, WITH, EXPLAIN, or allowlisted PRAGMA statement

name: adb_sqlite_inspect
